slides.text: signs you tie your worth to *being productive*
you feel guilty on days off
"what did you do today?" makes you nervous
you list your tasks when someone asks how you are
you only let yourself rest once you're exhausted

slides.label: my weekend affirmation
slides.text: you're worthy on the days you get nothing done
slides.affirmation: Rest is not a reward. It's a need.

slides.text: save this for your next *lazy Sunday*
